children: flyExclusive entered into a Sixth Amendment to its Aircraft Management Services Agreement with Volato, extending the term to December 31, 2026. The agreement continues flyExclusive's role as the exclusive provider of aircraft management services for Volato's fleet. The amendment keeps the remaining asset purchase and sale options in effect through the extended term. The previously disclosed merger option has expired and is not part of this extension.

: Extend exclusive aircraft management partnership and keep asset options active
